metadata.description: Give Claude video input and output. /watch downloads, extracts frames and transcribes; /make-video renders motion graphics and explainers from code.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (frames + transcript) and make videos with code: /watch (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, captions/Whisper) and /make-video (JavaScript frames → headless Chromium → ffmpeg MP4, narration, music, seven styles).
